name: eng-dev-handbook
summary: Advises minimal technology choice, bounded implementation, focused unit evidence, DEV self-check, and implementation handoff.
input_contract: Supplied acceptance, current runtime and dependencies, affected path and contracts, operating constraints, validation scope, authority, and requested implementation boundary.
output_contract: One bounded stack or implementation result with acceptance mapping, focused evidence, self-check findings, changed artifacts, known risks, rollback seam, and stop point.
